load_embedding: load a vision embedding model (vip, r3m, or resnet) with its image transform pipeline
main_run_curves: run embedding distance curve plotting for all videos in demo_realrobot directory
plot_reward_curves: plot normalized embedding distance curves comparing VIP, ResNet, and R3M representations
compute_goal_distances: compute normalized L2 distances between frame embeddings and the goal frame embedding
save_embedding_plots: save embedding distance comparison plots with goal frame inset to embedding_curves directory
